subject: Security & KMS follow-up — SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA questions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Park <john.park@finbank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Security & KMS follow-up — SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA questions

Hi John,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps from Redwood's side:

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for our hosted and dedicated offerings; I attached a short SOC 2 summary. If you need the full report we can initiate an NDA + secure transfer.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency controls and can sign a BAA for HIPAA-covered workloads; we'll need to scope which data types will be covered.
- Encryption & KMS:
  - At-rest: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.
  - In-transit: TLS 1.2+ / 1.3 for all transport.
  - Customer-managed keys (BYOK): Supported — we integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault. We also support HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM/Az HSM) for higher assurance.
  - Key separation: KV caches and ephemeral keys are handled by the runtime; persistent model artifacts and logs use the customer's KMS keys when BYOK is enabled.
- Vendor security questionnaire: I attached a link to our vendor portal where you can start the questionnaire. I'll also loop in Camila (sales engineering) and Neha (security) to help with any technical questions.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether FinBank requires a BAA for this project and whether the evaluation scope includes PHI.
2) If you want BYOK, share which cloud KMS provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) and any key IDs you plan to use — we can run a short integration test.
3) I'll schedule a 30‑minute technical call with Camila & Neha — proposed times below.

Proposed times (PST): Wed 12/16 9:00–11:00 or Thu 12/17 14:00–16:00 — let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, KMS_integration_guide.pdf, vendor_security_questionnaire_link.txt

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Security & KMS follow-up — SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA questions

Thanks, Marissa — helpful summary.

A few clarifications from FinBank:
- SOC 2: We require vendors to be SOC 2 Type II compliant. Does Redwood's SOC 2 cover your hosted API and any logs/access to customer data? If full report is available after an NDA that works.
- HIPAA/BAA: There is a potential PHI scope for one of our customers. We'll likely require a BAA.
- BYOK: We prefer AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM). Can Redwood support CloudHSM-backed CMKs, and can you confirm the operational steps for rotating keys?
- Questionnaire: We'll start the vendor questionnaire today. Can you provide a point of contact for any backend/architectural questions?

Thanks,
John Park

Hi John — quick answers inline and next steps.

- SOC 2: Our SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted API and all production logs/access relevant to customer workloads. We can provide the full report post-NDA; I've attached a short summary for now.
- BAA/HIPAA: We can sign a BAA. To scope it correctly, please indicate which data classes (e.g., PHI fields) and which routes/pipelines will handle PHI.
- CloudHSM/BYOK: Yes — we support AWS KMS CMKs backed by CloudHSM. Key rotation is customer-driven; Redwood supports key rewrap and we'll coordinate a short maintenance window for re-encrypting persisted artifacts when required. See the attached KMS_integration_guide.pdf for the integration steps and sample IAM policy.
- Questionnaire: Point of contact for technical questions: Camila Reyes (camila.reyes@redwood.ai) — she'll lead the integration work. Neha (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai) is our security SME for compliance questions.

I've created a vendor questionnaire record here: https://redwood.app.secure/questionnaire/finbank-RBW-2384
Please upload the completed questionnaire; we'll respond within 3 business days for outstanding items.

Can we lock in Wed 12/16 10:00 PST for a 30-minute technical sync? I've tentatively scheduled it; Camila & Neha are on the invite.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: KMS_integration_guide.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf
